title: Poetry
note: Quiet moral reckoning on guilt, beauty, and complicity; deeply sincere.

title: La La Land
note: Lush craft and bittersweet ending; thin beneath nostalgic homage.

title: Seven Samurai
note: Foundational action grammar; humane, kinetic, inexhaustible classic.

title: In the Mood for Love
note: Indelible mood and restraint; longing rendered as pure form.

title: Parasite
note: Tight class allegory; entertaining, controlled, slightly schematic finale.

title: City Lights
note: Final scene indelible; sentiment earned, comic timing peerless.

title: Spirited Away
note: Inexhaustible imagination; coming-of-age wonder that lingers for years.

title: The Godfather
note: American tragedy of moral corrosion; impeccable, endlessly rewatchable.

title: 12 Angry Men
note: Masterful single-room tension; civic ethics persuasive though somewhat tidy.

title: A Separation
note: Moral labyrinth where everyone is right; tense, fair, devastating.

title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
note: Gaze and memory theorized through romance; controlled, lingering imagery.

title: Moonlight
note: Tender triptych of identity; tactile, restrained, emotionally durable.

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
note: Perceptual revolution; cinema as cosmic metaphysics, endlessly inexhaustible.

title: The Tree of Life
note: Cosmic-domestic grace and grief; some find transcendent, others diffuse.

title: Mulholland Drive
note: Dream-logic masterwork on Hollywood and desire; reorganizes interpretation.

title: Synecdoche, New York
note: Sprawling meditation on art, mortality, self; ambitious, divisive, profound.

title: Jeanne Dielman
note: Radical duration redefines screen time and domestic labor; demanding.

title: Antichrist
note: Grief and misogyny provocations; formally striking, deliberately repellent, split.

title: Holy Motors
note: Protean ode to performance and cinema's mutations; inventive, episodic.

title: Uncut Gems
note: Relentless anxiety machine; visceral craft, thematically thin compulsion.

title: Beau Is Afraid
note: Maximalist anxiety odyssey; ambitious yet exhausting, indulgent, sharply divisive.

title: Close-Up
note: Reality/fiction collapse interrogates cinema and identity; quietly revolutionary.

title: Enemy
note: Dread-soaked doppelganger puzzle; atmospheric, cryptic, more riddle than reckoning.

title: Climax
note: Hypnotic descent into chaos; formally bravura but provocation over substance.

title: Batman Returns
note: Gothic auteur blockbuster; distinctive design, tonally uneven studio spectacle.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
note: Superb practical spectacle; crowd-pleasing nostalgia, thematically conservative comfort.

title: Ocean's Eleven
note: Effortlessly cool caper; impeccable craft, deliberately weightless entertainment.

title: Ant-Man
note: Light heist comedy; competent formula, disposable franchise product.

title: John Wick
note: Balletic gun-fu world-building; choreography pristine, narrative deliberately minimal.

title: Crazy Rich Asians
note: Glossy rom-com with representation milestone; conventional, crowd-pleasing wish-fulfillment.

title: The Hangover
note: Reverse-mystery comedy; brisk, replayable jokes, ethically careless raunch.

title: Jurassic World
note: Cynical nostalgia reboot; loud spectacle, self-aware yet hollow.

title: Knives Out
note: Clever whodunit with class satire; ingenious plotting, lightly didactic.

title: The Intouchables
note: Warm crowd-pleaser; affecting yet sentimental, criticized for racial tidiness.

title: Free Guy
note: Brand-laden meta-comedy; amiable concept diluted by corporate self-congratulation.

title: Babylon
note: Maximalist Hollywood excess; ostentatious energy, undisciplined sprawl, fiercely split.

title: Cloud Atlas
note: Ambitious nested epic; sincere reach exceeds coherence, deeply polarizing.

title: The Counselor
note: Bleak nihilist parable; baroque dialogue, cold and willfully alienating.

title: Joker
note: Scorsese pastiche of alienation; striking lead, derivative and ideologically muddled.

title: Don't Look Up
note: Blunt climate satire; smug, self-congratulatory, preaches without illumination.

title: Star Wars: The Last Jedi
note: Franchise subversion; genuine ideas, fan war creates real critical split.

title: Sucker Punch
note: Empowerment claim undercut by leering spectacle; incoherent, vulgar style-over-substance.

title: Spring Breakers
note: Hypnotic critique of hedonism; intentional excess, genuinely split reception.

title: The Fountain
note: Earnest cosmic meditation on death; visually rich, divisive earnest reach.

title: Southland Tales
note: Sprawling apocalyptic satire; ambitious chaos, near-incoherent, cult-divisive mess.

title: Suicide Squad
note: Studio-mangled product; tonal whiplash, hollow needle-drops, cynically assembled.

title: Vox Lux
note: Cold pop-culture-and-terror essay; formally bold, chilly, sharply divisive.

title: Avatar: The Way of Water
note: Immersive technical marvel; sensory spectacle wrapped around thin, familiar narrative.

title: Mamma Mia!
note: Buoyant jukebox confection; ramshackle craft, infectious joy over substance.

title: Now You See Me
note: Flashy magician caper; misdirection masks plot cheating, hollow spectacle.
